/bin/zsh -lc "python3 <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path

kb_path = Path('server/kristy_perimeter_kb.json')
pin_path = Path('server/test/acceptance/twoLinePin.js')
kb_text = kb_path.read_text()
pin_text = pin_path.read_text()
kb = json.loads(kb_text)
quartz = {
    'name': 'Quartz: Here is why your farmed salmon has color added to it',
    'url': 'https://qz.com/358811/heres-why-your-farmed-salmon-has-color-added-to-it',
}
additions = {
    'salmon_wild_vs_farmed': {
        'buying_tips': [
            'A 2004 Science study tested 14 contaminants, including PCBs and dioxins. All 14 were higher in farmed salmon than wild. The levels were well below FDA tolerance levels for bought fish.',
            'Choose wild Alaskan salmon, fresh or frozen, first. Canned wild salmon comes next. For farmed salmon, read the country of origin.',
        ],
        'watch_out': [
            'A 2004 Science study found all 14 contaminants higher in farmed salmon than wild. Levels were well below FDA tolerance levels for bought fish.',
            'Seafood Watch rates two-thirds of Chilean farmed salmon red for high antibiotic use.',
        ],
        'sources': [
            {'name': 'WebMD via NBC News: Do risks of farmed salmon outweigh benefits?', 'url': 'https://www.nbcnews.com/id/wbna3980525'},
            {'name': 'Monterey Bay Aquarium: Farmed salmon in Chile', 'url': 'https://www.montereybayaquarium.org/change-impact/our-conservation-work/global-ocean-conservation-programs/global-seafood-projects/farmed-salmon-in-chile'},
        ],
    },
    'smoked_salmon': {
        'buying_tips': [
            'Wild salmon get their color from krill and shrimp. Farmed salmon flesh is gray until astaxanthin in the feed sets the pink.',
            'Choose smoked wild salmon first. For farmed smoked salmon, read the country of origin.',
        ],
        'watch_out': ['‘Color added’ means the feed was pigmented.'],
        'sources': [quartz],
    },
    'label_wild_vs_farm_raised': {
        'buying_tips': [
            'On farm-raised salmon, ‘color added’ means the feed was pigmented. Farmed flesh is gray until astaxanthin in the feed sets the pink. Wild salmon get their color from krill and shrimp.',
            'For salmon, choose wild-caught first. For farm-raised salmon, read the country of origin.',
        ],
        'watch_out': ['Color added means the feed was pigmented. It does not mean the fish was colored after harvest.'],
        'sources': [quartz],
    },
}

def render(value, indent):
    return '\\n'.join(' ' * indent + line for line in json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2).splitlines())

for card_id, fields in additions.items():
    entry = next(e for e in kb['entries'] if e['id'] == card_id)
    old_entry = render(entry, 4)
    old_pin = '  ' + json.dumps(card_id) + ': ' + render({key: entry[key] for key in ['decision', 'buying_tips']}, 2).lstrip()
    assert kb_text.count(old_entry) == 1, card_id
    assert pin_text.count(old_pin) == 1, card_id
    for field, values in fields.items():
        entry[field].extend(values)
    new_pin = '  ' + json.dumps(card_id) + ': ' + render({key: entry[key] for key in ['decision', 'buying_tips', 'watch_out', 'sources']}, 2).lstrip()
    kb_text = kb_text.replace(old_entry, render(entry, 4), 1)
    pin_text = pin_text.replace(old_pin, new_pin, 1)

concern_start = pin_text.index('const CONCERN = new Set([')
concern_end = pin_text.index(']);', concern_start)
pin_text = pin_text[:concern_end] + \", 'salmon_wild_vs_farmed', 'smoked_salmon', 'label_wild_vs_farm_raised'\" + pin_text[concern_end:]
kb_path.write_text(kb_text)
pin_path.write_text(pin_text)
print('Updated three cards, their inline pins, and CONCERN membership.')
PY"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 <<'PY'
import subprocess
import sys
result = subprocess.run(['npm', 'test'], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True)
lines = result.stdout.splitlines()
print('\\n'.join(line for line in lines if line.startswith(('> ', 'ℹ ', '✖ '))))
marker = next((i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if 'failing tests:' in line), None)
if marker is not None:
    print('\\n'.join(lines[marker:]))
elif result.returncode:
    print('\\n'.join(lines[-100:]))
print(f'npm test exit code: {result.returncode}')
sys.exit(result.returncode)
PY"
